targets.rawSql:
WITH audit_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
                AND COALESCE(
                    outcome,
                    'UNKNOWN'
                ) NOT IN (
                    'SUCCESS',
                    'SUCCEEDED',
                    'COMPLETED',
                    'OK'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS audit_bad,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                occurred_at
                >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

                AND COALESCE(
                    outcome,
                    'UNKNOWN'
                ) NOT IN (
                    'SUCCESS',
                    'SUCCEEDED',
                    'COMPLETED',
                    'OK'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS audit_1h,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
                AND action = 'DEPENDENCY_DEGRADED'
                AND outcome IN (
                    'WARNING',
                    'FAILED'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS dependency_bad,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
                AND outcome IN (
                    'FAILED',
                    'ERROR'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS critical,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
                AND outcome = 'WARNING'
        )::bigint
            AS warning

    FROM audit_auditlog
),

ai_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                AND status IN (
                    'FAILED',
                    'ERROR',
                    'TIMEOUT',
                    'CANCELLED'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS ai_bad,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                requested_at
                >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

                AND status IN (
                    'FAILED',
                    'ERROR',
                    'TIMEOUT',
                    'CANCELLED'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS ai_1h

    FROM ai_aianalysis
)

SELECT
    (
        audit_stats.audit_bad
        + ai_stats.ai_bad
    )::bigint
        AS "INCIDENT_TOTAL",

    audit_stats.audit_bad
        AS "AUDIT_BAD",

    ai_stats.ai_bad
        AS "AI_BAD",

    (
        audit_stats.audit_1h
        + ai_stats.ai_1h
    )::bigint
        AS "INCIDENT_1H",

    audit_stats.dependency_bad
        AS "DEPENDENCY_BAD",

    (
        audit_stats.critical
        + ai_stats.ai_bad
    )::bigint
        AS "CRITICAL",

    audit_stats.warning
        AS "WARNING"

FROM audit_stats
CROSS JOIN ai_stats

panels.title: 운영 이상 발생 추이 · Audit vs AI

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS (
    SELECT
        occurred_at AS ts,
        'AUDIT'::text AS source
    FROM audit_auditlog
    WHERE
        COALESCE(
            outcome,
            'UNKNOWN'
        ) NOT IN (
            'SUCCESS',
            'SUCCEEDED',
            'COMPLETED',
            'OK'
        )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        requested_at AS ts,
        'AI'::text AS source
    FROM ai_aianalysis
    WHERE status IN (
        'FAILED',
        'ERROR',
        'TIMEOUT',
        'CANCELLED'
    )
)

SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(
        ts,
        '1h'
    ),

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE source = 'AUDIT'
    )::double precision AS "Audit",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE source = 'AI'
    )::double precision AS "AI"

FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 최근 운영 이상 이벤트

targets.rawSql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        occurred_at AS "발생 시각",
        'Audit'::text AS "구분",
        source_service AS "서비스",
        action AS "이벤트",
        outcome AS "상태",
        COALESCE(
            reason,
            '-'
        ) AS "상세",
        COALESCE(
            request_id::text,
            '-'
        ) AS "추적 ID"

    FROM audit_auditlog

    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
        AND COALESCE(
            outcome,
            'UNKNOWN'
        ) NOT IN (
            'SUCCESS',
            'SUCCEEDED',
            'COMPLETED',
            'OK'
        )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        requested_at AS "발생 시각",
        'AI'::text AS "구분",
        'AI Inference'::text AS "서비스",
        analysis_type AS "이벤트",
        status AS "상태",
        COALESCE(
            failure_code,
            '-'
        ) AS "상세",
        COALESCE(
            trace_id,
            '-'
        ) AS "추적 ID"

    FROM ai_aianalysis

    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(requested_at)
        AND status IN (
            'FAILED',
            'ERROR',
            'TIMEOUT',
            'CANCELLED'
        )
) incidents

ORDER BY "발생 시각" DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: 최근 내부 서비스 이상 상세

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    occurred_at
        AS "발생 시각",

    request_id::text
        AS "Request ID",

    COALESCE(
        resource_id,
        '-'
    ) AS "API Route",

    outcome
        AS "운영 상태",

    COALESCE(
        reason,
        '-'
    ) AS "요약",

    COALESCE(
        after_json -> 'failures',
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS "세부 실패"

FROM audit_auditlog

WHERE
    $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND action = 'DEPENDENCY_DEGRADED'

ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

LIMIT 100
